narratives.Description: security(cache): hard-fail fine-grained github_pat_ tokens in scanner (cache-quarantine-01). This story remediates a confirmed AppSec finding from tracker #2904 with fail-closed tests and CHANGELOG citation. Parent umbrella remains open until all batch children merge.
narratives.Overview:
## Parent
Part of AppSec scan tracker **#2904** (2026-07-29). Remediation **Batch B** (Windows shell + PAT scanner).

## Finding
| | |
| --- | --- |
| **ID** | `cache-quarantine-01` |
| **Severity** | **High** |
| **Dimension** | `cache-quarantine` |
| **File** | [`packages/core/src/cache/scanner.ts`](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/master/packages/core/src/cache/scanner.ts) |

## Issue
`CREDENTIAL_PATTERNS` matches classic `gh[pousr]_…` but **not** fine-grained `github_pat_…`. Product-signal already knows `github_pat_` — inconsistent coverage. Fine-grained PATs pass into `content.md` and xBRIEF narratives.

## Impact
Leaked fine-grained PAT in issue title/body/comment lands in LLM-facing cache/ingest instead of fail-closed.

## Remediation
1. Add `github_pat_` pattern aligned with product-signal.
2. Extend scanner tests; bump `SCANNER_VERSION`.
3. Optionally re-scan existing cache on version skew.

## Acceptance
- [ ] `github_pat_` hard-fails in `scan()` / detectCredentials
- [ ] Tests cover fine-grained PAT fixtures
- [ ] `SCANNER_VERSION` bumped; sinks (cache put, issue:ingest, umbrella) inherit fail-closed

## Refs
- Tracker #2904
- Batch B sibling: subprocess-scm-01
- `packages/core/src/product-signal/payload.ts` SECRET_PATTERNS
narratives.UserStory: As a security engineer, I want hard-fail fine-grained github_pat_ tokens in the cache scanner, so that issue ingest and cache content cannot persist modern GitHub PATs for agents.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Add github_pat_ pattern to CREDENTIAL_PATTERNS in packages/core/src/cache/scanner.ts aligned with product-signal SECRET_PATTERNS. Bump SCANNER_VERSION. Extend unit tests with fine-grained PAT fixtures. Confirm cache put / issue-ingest / umbrella sinks inherit hard-fail. CHANGELOG cites #2910.
